formula: unsafe ~ C(max_private_risk) + first_round_unsafe + own_prev_unsafe * opponent_prev_unsafe * progress_gap_before + C(protocol_signature)
interpretation: This is a sensitivity diagnostic, not an inferential test: the leave-one-out spread is not a standard error and has no p-value.
jackknife: One refit per source_run/model/rep common-random-number block, each omitting that block. sign_stable is False if the full-sample coefficient and any leave-one-out coefficient disagree in sign.
skipped_block_note: A block whose removal makes the model unidentified or non-convergent is listed rather than recorded as a zero coefficient.
specification: 6 (saturated), plus the protocol controls of the main fit

variants.exclude_min_horizon: races that stopped at the 5-round minimum
variants.exclude_retried_races: races where at least one decision needed a generation retry
variants.full: every race in the behavioural sample
